description: Aggregate Core billing account status. Active subscriptions are not confirmed cash payments. No user-level data.

options.content: One customer organization = one billing account, including missing billing rows. **These are not users or engaged humans. Active subscription ≠ confirmed cash payment.** Core-recorded state can lag Stripe webhooks. Refreshed every 5 minutes; failed, missing, future-dated or ≥10-minute-old snapshots are unavailable. Counts are not filled with zero during outages.

panels.title: All billing accounts
panels.description: All customer organizations, including missing billing records. Sum of the nine exclusive categories.

targets.expr: sum (finite_billing_accounts{instance="finite-lat-2",job="finite-internal-health"} and on (job, instance) ((finite_billing_collection_success{instance="finite-lat-2",job="finite-internal-health"} == 1) and on (job, instance) (up{instance="finite-lat-2",job="finite-internal-health"} == 1) and on (job, instance) (time() - finite_billing_collected_at_seconds{instance="finite-lat-2",job="finite-internal-health"} >= 0) and on (job, instance) (time() - finite_billing_collected_at_seconds{instance="finite-lat-2",job="finite-internal-health"} < 600)))

panels.description: UNAVAILABLE means failure, missing scrape/export, a future timestamp, or age ≥10 minutes. Current is collection freshness, not Stripe synchronization freshness.

panels.description: Mutually exclusive categories. Zero is a successful snapshot with no accounts in that category.

targets.expr: sum by (status) (finite_billing_accounts{instance="finite-lat-2",job="finite-internal-health"} and on (job, instance) ((finite_billing_collection_success{instance="finite-lat-2",job="finite-internal-health"} == 1) and on (job, instance) (up{instance="finite-lat-2",job="finite-internal-health"} == 1) and on (job, instance) (time() - finite_billing_collected_at_seconds{instance="finite-lat-2",job="finite-internal-health"} >= 0) and on (job, instance) (time() - finite_billing_collected_at_seconds{instance="finite-lat-2",job="finite-internal-health"} < 600)))

options.content:
Every organization appears once. Evaluation order:

1. **missing_billing_account** — no billing row.
2. **unknown** — unknown billing class/status, blank subscription ID, or only one of subscription ID/status present.
3. **subscribed** — stored status `active`, even if cancellation is scheduled. No receipt or invoice verification.
4. **sponsored / grandfathered** — matching billing class, after the checks above; exemptions take precedence over trial/inactive status.
5. **trial** — standard, `trialing`, deadline in the future. Deadline is period end, falling back to redeemed-at + campaign days for a redeemed trial. Unknown if neither exists.
6. **expired_past_due** — standard with elapsed trial (deadline inclusive), `past_due`, `unpaid`, `canceled`, `paused`, or `incomplete_expired`.
7. **incomplete** — standard, checkout subscription is `incomplete`.
8. **no_subscription** — standard, billing row exists with both subscription ID and status absent. A customer ID alone does not imply a subscription.

Trial reservations alone do not prove a trial. Historical snapshots reflect recorded billing state, not revenue or human engagement.

panels.title: Billing account state over time
panels.description: Point-in-time gauges of Core state; gaps are unavailable collection. No historical counts are backfilled.

targets.expr: sum by (status) (finite_billing_accounts{instance="finite-lat-2",job="finite-internal-health"} and on (job, instance) ((finite_billing_collection_success{instance="finite-lat-2",job="finite-internal-health"} == 1) and on (job, instance) (up{instance="finite-lat-2",job="finite-internal-health"} == 1) and on (job, instance) (time() - finite_billing_collected_at_seconds{instance="finite-lat-2",job="finite-internal-health"} >= 0) and on (job, instance) (time() - finite_billing_collected_at_seconds{instance="finite-lat-2",job="finite-internal-health"} < 600)))
